name: Sierra de Yeguas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sierra de Yeguas (a mountain range, a horse and the bars of Aragon).
history: Municipal flag of Sierra de Yeguas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sierra de Yeguas arms — mountain range, horse and the bars of Aragon
